one_liner: An AWS SecOps agent deployed into each client's own AWS account that discovers all resources, runs read-only security checks, ranks findings by risk, and shows a posture dashboard with Bedrock-generated explanations.

delivery_model.how: We take this repo and deploy it directly into the client's AWS account (their EKS). The agent runs 24/7 inside their account.
delivery_model.access: Client has full admin. We get temporary deploy access via what PREREQUISITES.md lists. After deploy it is their account; we do not retain access.
delivery_model.safety: READ-ONLY and recommend-only. Never changes, deletes, or remediates anything in AWS.

language_decision.primary: Pure Go (single static binary, k8s-native, small image).
language_decision.no_python: No Python anywhere. The 'ML/AI' layer is Amazon Bedrock (a hosted API) called via the Go SDK, so no local ML runtime is needed.

dropped: The old CodeSentinel file scanner (Semgrep/Gitleaks/Trivy) is NOT part of this product.
GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector are NOT used (trial-only, then paid). Rely on free read-only AWS APIs + open-source Prowler.

architecture.internal/types: Core domain types (Resource, Finding, RiskFactors, PostureReview, Explanation).
architecture.internal/discovery: Read-only AWS resource inventory grouped by service (ec2,s3,iam,lambda,rds,dynamodb,eks).
architecture.internal/collectors: Read-only security checks. ownchecks.go (own checks) + prowler.go (ingests Prowler OCSF JSON from shared dir; robust parser handles single array / concatenated arrays / NDJSON; maps metadata.event_code->control, derives service from check-id prefix; only FAIL surfaced). prowler_test.go validates against real OCSF (skips unless NEXOGENT_OCSF_TESTFILE set).
architecture.internal/ranking: Deterministic risk rubric: severity 0.40, exposure 0.25, reachability 0.20, resource_criticality 0.15 -> 0..100. Posture score penalties CRIT20/HIGH12/MED5/LOW2. Ratings 90 Excellent/75 Good/60 Needs Improvement/else Critical. HAS TESTS.
architecture.internal/bedrock: Bedrock Claude explanations with offline fallback (never breaks the demo).
architecture.internal/api: HTTP API: GET /health, POST /api/v1/review, GET /api/v1/review/latest, GET /api/v1/resources (grouped by service), POST /api/v1/explain?review=&finding=.
architecture.dashboard/: React dashboard (Vite). src/App.jsx (posture header, service sidebar, findings list, explain drawer), api.js, styles.css. Built + served by unprivileged Nginx (dashboard/Dockerfile, nginx.conf proxies /api+/health to nexogent-backend).
architecture.deploy/helm/nexogent: Helm chart — MICROSERVICES: backend.yaml (Go agent Deployment+Service, IRSA, pullPolicy Always), frontend.yaml (React/Nginx Deployment+Service, unprivileged nginx uid101 + writable emptyDirs for conf/cache/run/tmp), prowler-cronjob.yaml (Prowler CronJob, runAsUser 1000, entrypoint takes args — NO command override), prowler-install-job.yaml (post-install hook), prowler-pvc.yaml (shared EBS PVC gp2 RWO), ingress.yaml (ALB: / -> frontend, /api+/health -> backend), serviceaccount.yaml (IRSA SA shared by backend+prowler), _helpers.tpl, NOTES.txt, values.yaml.

aws_context.iam_user_local_profile: admin-sri (configured locally via aws configure; do NOT paste keys in chat)

cluster_addons_installed: Installed on eks-lab (see deploy/CLUSTER_PREREQS.md): aws-ebs-csi-driver addon (IRSA role AmazonEKS_EBS_CSI_DriverRole) for the shared PVC; AWS Load Balancer Controller v2.9.2 in kube-system (IRSA role AmazonEKSLoadBalancerControllerRole, policy AWSLoadBalancerControllerIAMPolicy) for the ALB ingress (ingressclass 'alb').
gotchas_learned: image tag 'latest' + pullPolicy IfNotPresent = node keeps stale image; MUST use pullPolicy Always for mutable latest (fixed in values.yaml).

toniblyx/prowler ENTRYPOINT is /home/prowler/.venv/bin/prowler (not on PATH) and USER is non-numeric 'prowler' -> do NOT override command, pass args only, and set runAsUser:1000 so runAsNonRoot can verify.
nginx:alpine runs as root (fails runAsNonRoot) -> use nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged (uid 101) + emptyDir mounts on /etc/nginx/conf.d,/var/cache/nginx,/run,/tmp (pid file is /run/nginx.pid).
Prowler OCSF file can be concatenated arrays across runs -> collector uses a streaming json.Decoder.
gp2 storageclass needs the EBS CSI driver in k8s 1.37 (in-tree provisioner gone).
